Here is our runbook:

# Runbook: Payment API alerts

## When this fires
The PagerDuty alert "payments-5xx" fires when the 5xx rate stays above 2% for 5 minutes.

## First steps
1. Open the Payments dashboard and check the 5xx panel.
2. Check the latest deploy in the #releases channel.
3. If a deploy happened in the last hour, roll it back first.

## Escalation
- If not resolved in 15 minutes, page the secondary on-call.
- If customer payments are failing, notify the incident manager.

## Contacts
- Primary on-call: see the PagerDuty schedule "payments-primary".
- Incident manager: #incident-command

What is missing from it?
Two gaps: it never says how to confirm recovery, and it does not name a second contact. Consider a Recovery section with a concrete check, and add the secondary on-call channel under Contacts.
Change the escalation time from 15 to 10 minutes, and add a Recovery section after Escalation: confirm the 5xx rate is under 0.5% for 10 minutes before closing the alert.

Under ## Escalation the first bullet now says "If not resolved in 10 minutes, page the secondary on-call." New section after Escalation:

## Recovery
- Confirm the 5xx rate is under 0.5% for 10 minutes before closing the alert.

The rest is unchanged.
Also add the secondary on-call contact to Contacts: #payments-secondary.

Under ## Contacts add:

- Secondary on-call: #payments-secondary

The rest is unchanged.
Give me the complete final runbook so I can paste it into the wiki.

required_facts: The alert description is present: "payments-5xx" fires when the 5xx rate stays above 2% for 5 minutes
The three First steps are all present, including rolling back a deploy made in the last hour
Escalation says 10 minutes (not 15) and still includes notifying the incident manager if customer payments fail
A Recovery section requires the 5xx rate under 0.5% for 10 minutes before closing the alert
Contacts include the primary on-call (PagerDuty schedule "payments-primary"), the incident manager (#incident-command), and the secondary on-call (#payments-secondary)
The text is complete, with no placeholders or elision markers
critical_omissions: Using "...", "unchanged" or similar placeholders in place of any section
Missing any of the three earlier changes, or still saying 15 minutes
Dropping an original section or item
unnecessary_repetition: Re-explaining what the runbook was missing
Commentary on each edit beyond a one-line note
